history.title: Release history
history.subtitle: Every release recorded in the signed index, newest first. Product, version and publisher all come from the index itself.
history.syncFailed: The market index is temporarily unreachable; showing records already stored
history.publishedAtHint: Uses the CDN file's Last-Modified when available; otherwise falls back to the index build time, tagged “index time”

page.title: Publishing
page.subtitle: A publishing credential is single-use: redeeming it mints a long-lived publishing identity (key_id).

apply.title: Request publishing credential
apply.productExtra: The solution name you are publishing (lowercase, a-z0-9- only). Identity = product + your username; it cannot be changed later.

issued.title: Credential created (shown once)
issued.warning: You will not be able to view it again. Copy it now, or copy the command below.

revoke.confirm: Revoking invalidates this credential immediately. Continue?

trustReview.title: Trust review (superadmin)
trustReview.desc: A first install from an unknown publisher stops at needs_trust; the public-key fingerprint is submitted with the install task. Verify the publisher and fingerprint, then approve to add the key to the trust store so the installer can retry.

offlineUpload.title: Offline package upload (intranet upgrade)
offlineUpload.desc: No publisher private key inside the intranet: upload the signed package (.tgz + .sig sidecar) and the server verifies the pair on the spot (signature bound to the exact bytes). Packages whose publisher fingerprint is not in the trust store are still catalogued; installation pauses at needs_trust until a superadmin approves and the install is retried.
offlineUpload.needBoth: Select both the package and the signature sidecar
offlineUpload.pairMismatch: The two files must pair by name: the .sig file should be "{{tgz}}.sig"
offlineUpload.untrusted: Publisher not in trust store: install pauses at needs_trust until approved, then retry
offlineUpload.idempotent: Same-byte re-upload handled idempotently (catalog and files self-healed)
